c162.title: Who Stole Max's Bike?
c162.story: One morning, Max's bike was gone from the street outside his building. He called the [[cops|cop]], and a young [[detective]] named Koval came an hour later. On the street camera, they saw the [[silhouette]] of a tall man at night. Koval knew him: a local guy with a history of [[shoplifting]] and [[vandalism]]. He had an [[alibi]]: he said he was at his aunt's house all night. The next day, he came back on the [[pretext]] of walking his dog. Koval checked his [[dossier]] and asked for a [[polygraph]] test. Before the test even started, the young [[vandal]] confessed. He and an old soccer [[hooligan]] friend took the bike as a stupid joke. That evening, a friendly [[policeman]] brought the bike back to Max. Max's grandpa smiled: "In old British novels, he would be a [[constable]]." "And in cowboy movies, he would be the [[sheriff]]," Max laughed.

c164.title: Gangs and Drugs
c164.story: On Friday night, Max watched an old film about the [[mafia]] with his dad. In it, an old [[gangster]] flies to Tokyo to meet the [[yakuza]]. The two groups start a long [[vendetta]] over drug [[trafficking]]. Soon a rival drug [[cartel]] wants the same routes. Behind them all is a huge crime [[syndicate]]. In the end, a police [[raid]] stops everything in one night. In the basement, the police find a [[bong]], a [[pistol]], an old [[revolver]], and a [[shotgun]]. An expert checks the [[caliber]] of every bullet. Max's dad fell asleep before the end, so Max had to tell him everything.

c165.title: A True-Crime Podcast
c165.story: Anna listens to a true-crime podcast on her way to class. This week, the host talks about a [[maniac]] from an old case. One doctor calls him a [[psychopath]], but another says he was more of a [[sociopath]]. Both agree that he was a [[sadist]] who enjoyed other people's pain. He was also a cruel [[abuser]], and his family lived with years of [[abuse]]. Later, he began [[stalking]] young women in his town. The police finally stopped him after a failed [[kidnapping]] with [[chloroform]]. In the second part, an expert explains how to protect children from a [[pedophile]] online. She also explains why [[incest]] and other family crimes often stay hidden. Then a [[coroner]] describes her work in the city [[morgue]]. She laughs and says her hobby is [[cannibalism]] in spiders. Anna takes off her headphones and decides to listen to music tonight.

c167.title: Max Builds a Computer
c167.story: Max decided to build his own computer instead of buying one. He spread all the new parts over the kitchen table. First, he read the [[manual]] carefully, page by page. He checked every [[component]] and placed the [[processor]], the main [[chip]], very gently. He pushed extra memory into each [[slot]] for faster games. Then he tested the keyboard [[input]] and the screen [[output]] with a small program. A tiny error appeared, but he fixed it in five minutes. That evening, his friend Ira brought an old [[prototype]] from her grandfather's garage. Its [[transistors|transistor]] were huge, and it could hold only one [[byte]] at a time. Max laughed: his new computer was a million times faster.

c168.title: Max Learns Coding
c168.story: At Max's company, a [[programmer]] named Lena offered to teach him [[coding]]. Her official title is [[software engineer]], but she says it is the same job. On his first day, Max wrote a simple [[test case]] for the login page. A [[tester]] ran it and then read the [[log]] with him. Next, the team started a small [[open source]] project: a friendly help [[bot]]. The bot answers any [[prompt]] about the city's buses. Soon a [[contributor]] from Lviv added a [[plug-in]] for the weather. It uses a free weather [[API]], so the bot knows when it rains. A week later, a student made a small [[add-on]] with train times too. Max asked the bot, "Do I need an umbrella?" It said yes. That night, Max felt brave and made his first [[mod]] for his favorite game. Next week, the bot goes to real users, and Max is a little nervous.
